capabilities: Generate fill-in-the-middle suggestions from surrounding text using LLMs
Display and partially accept inline suggestions via keyboard
Support multiple API providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Ollama
Customize triggers, few-shot examples, system prompt, and generation settings
Ignore files matching gitignore-like patterns for privacy
disambiguation: Not an AI chat assistant; it only suggests text inline at the cursor and accepts no conversations.
extras: Sends note content to external API providers; README includes a privacy disclaimer and suggests local Ollama models, ignore patterns, or manual disable for sensitive documents. Uses triggered (not continuous) predictions to reduce API cost.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a Copilot-like auto-completion to Obsidian.
motivation: The README explains it adapts LLMs, which are not trained for fill-in-the-middle, to auto-completion via prompt engineering and few-shot examples, while minimizing API calls and costs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI text completion while typing; users want inline suggestions as they write without leaving the editor.

relations.evidence: Unlike Copilot, this plugin does not activate after each character you type

requires.name: OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API key

summary: AI auto-completion plugin that shows LLM-generated fill-in-the-middle suggestions as transparent text at the cursor, accepting them with Tab or arrow keys.
